name: halo
description: Browse Halo Basic Reports, event groups, and reporting sets with interactive React dashboards. Export any report as PowerPoint.
long_description: A read-only MCP server for the Halo Cross-Media Measurement API. Renders interactive React dashboards inline in the chat (KPI cards, ECharts visualizations, publisher breakdowns, weekly trends) and exports any report as a native PowerPoint deck.

halo_base_url.title: Halo API Base URL
halo_base_url.description: Public base URL of your Halo Kingdom's reporting API, e.g. https://api.example-halo.org

halo_mc_id.title: Measurement Consumer Resource Name
halo_mc_id.description: Your MC resource name, e.g. measurementConsumers/abc123

halo_auth0_url.title: Auth0 Tenant URL
halo_auth0_url.description: Your Auth0 tenant base URL, e.g. https://example.auth0.com

halo_auth0_audience.title: Auth0 API Audience
halo_auth0_audience.description: Auth0 audience identifier configured for the Halo API
